defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Press before a known burst of incoming damage to reduce all damage taken by 40 percent and prevent interrupts and silences for the duration.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Talent-gated: sacrifice current health for a large absorb shield ahead of a spike of magic damage; rotate it with Unending Resolve so a defensive is always available.

defensives.name: Healthstone
defensives.usage_rule: Use as an emergency instant heal when your health drops dangerously low and no other defensive is up; create one before combat so it is always ready.
